features.daemon: swtpm, private anonymous D-Bus and tpm2-abrmd supervised per operation; Linux subreaper, state/control leases, TCP plus bus-name plus native token readiness, bounded shutdown
features.native_uid: caller root or non-root, any primary group; no NSS wrapper
features.authentication: caller-selected SO/user PIN, non-empty through 4096 bytes single-line; persistent primary 0x81000001

reproducibility: Frozen source/package/build input identity; offline compilation. Emulator/token state persists on caller state and resumes across operations; byte-identical image rebuilding not asserted.
